name: Ribbon of frames
description: A curved strip of cards (photos or icon tiles) arches through frame, glowing at the base.

recipe.build: (No stage3d kit: a CSS 3D card ring built on rasan-camera.js.) Three.js strip with PlaneGeometry segments bent along a spline, a texture per card; or CSS 3D cards rotateY on a ring.

avoid: Do not use on 9:16 without re-bending; keep under 24 cards.

code.example: RasanMoves.ribbonOfFrames(tl, 0.2, { target: stage, images: [photo, photo2, photo3] });
